component.name: PlasmaLLM
component.summary: System-aware AI assistant for KDE Plasma

description.p: PlasmaLLM is a chat interface to LLM endpoints (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and any OpenAI-compatible API) that can gather system information, search the web and run shell commands with your approval.
This is the standalone window version of the PlasmaLLM Plasma widget.
